formal_name: CUBE-REV Generation VII G7-P20 — Independent-Fresh Cohort Effect-Size Heterogeneity, P17↔P19 Frozen HYBRID Complementarity Transport, Solve-Bootstrap Cohort-Difference Estimation, Fresh96 Descriptive Pooling, Era×Method×Reconstructor Interaction Stability & Successor-Contact Necessity Audit
interpretation: Both independent fresh48 cohorts favor HYBRID over HAND, but the magnitude difference is not resolved by the presealed 90% solve-bootstrap interval.
The pooled fresh96 descriptive interval remains HYBRID-favoring, but cannot be treated as independent confirmation because P17 generated the HYBRID successor rival.
Reconstructor-frequency band shows a coherent attenuation from P17 to P19 in both levels, but this is a post-result axis diagnostic rather than a confirmed causal or stable population coordinate.
Method and era surfaces do not show a single coherent localization that explains the cohort difference.
The correct decision is not to spend more untouched contact on the same aggregate HYBRID-vs-HAND contrast.
retained: Frozen predictive representation evidence is strong enough to justify moving to a different evidence channel rather than repeating aggregate confirmation.
demoted_or_forbidden: stable effect-size transport across fresh cohorts
additional fresh contact for the same aggregate contrast without a new discriminator
